plugins.name: extract-alpha
plugins.description: Remove background from AI-generated images using two-pass difference matting. Generate the same image on white and black backgrounds, then extract pixel-perfect transparency.

skills.name: extract-alpha
skills.description: Remove background from AI-generated (e.g. Gemini) images using two-pass difference matting. Use when the user has white/black background image pairs that need transparent backgrounds.

skills.name: prompt
skills.description: Generate a pair of AI image prompts (white + black background) ready for alpha extraction. Use when the user wants to create an image with transparency using the extract-alpha workflow.
headings: Step 1: Build the full image prompt
Option A: Use the prompt skill (recommended)
